title: The Export sheet's size for an edited video is close to what comes out
goal: The Export sheet told a person an edited 21 second video would be about 9.6 MB, and the MP4 it wrote was 0.7 MB. A size fourteen times too big makes people pick a smaller setting they did not need; the number shown before exporting should be near the file that lands.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-24, Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/an-editing-session-walk.json --no-build, step writeVideo: 'the-edit.mp4 is 693 KB (709860 bytes) ... it runs 20.94s at 1280 x 800 px, with sound on it; made frame by frame from the document; the sheet said "MP4 Video · about 9.6 MB"' (sheet default High, 8-export-sheet-sc.png). RecordingExport.weight takes min(budget, measuredCost); an assembled document (two recordings, a cut, a dissolve, a title, captions) evidently has no measured cost so it falls back to the recipe's ceiling (bits per second x length). Measuring off the clips' own source files (bytes per second per pixel, weighted by how long each plays) would give an answer for the edited case too.
acceptance: For an edited document made of screen recordings, the MP4 size the sheet shows is within a factor of two of the file written at the same setting
The line still says about, and an untouched recording still shows its exact size
an-editing-session-walk's export step logs a sheet size and a written size that agree within that factor
